title: Button Sizes, States, and Variations
learning_outcomes: Explain the purpose of button sizes, states, and variations and when it is appropriate.
Apply large and small buttons using the documented Bootstrap 5.3 pattern.
Check outline buttons and identify one likely failure mode.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will study button sizes, states, and variations and connect it to a small implementation or review task. The included subtopics preserve the attached Bootstrap curriculum outline.
content.why_it_matters: Button Sizes, States, and Variations gives an interface a recognizable pattern, but it does not replace good semantic HTML. Choose the component that matches the meaning of the content and test its action, focus, and responsive behavior.

common_mistakes.problem: Treating button sizes, states, and variations as a visual-only change.
common_mistakes.why: A class or style does not automatically add semantic meaning, application logic, or secure server behavior.
common_mistakes.fix: Use the appropriate HTML semantics and verify the actual interaction.

common_mistakes.problem: Checking only the default viewport or happy path.
common_mistakes.why: Responsive changes and interaction states can reveal issues that are not visible in a single screenshot.
common_mistakes.fix: Repeat the task at a narrow and a wide viewport and include keyboard/error state checks where relevant.
